method: percentile bootstrap over held-out runs, paired across methods; per-run metrics resampled, no refits
choice: B and seed are the analyst's choice made at analysis time (R17); the pre-registration asks for bootstrap intervals over runs but does not fix them
note: final test: 3 runs, intervals indicative only; H3a-H3c are defined on means and do not use these intervals; kinds with < 2 runs are skipped

paired_differences_post_hoc.label: POST HOC (final review, ruling R18): not pre-registered
paired_differences_post_hoc.definition: difference A - B of the per-method statistic on the same resampled runs as the marginal intervals; resolved = 95 % percentile interval excludes 0; below_floor = |mean difference| < the PD0 noise floor (0.157 m a-1 for rmse_map and rmse_gl, 1.3 % for |integrated_rel_error|); leaders = the best mean plus every method not resolved from it or within the floor
